about.heading: A short introduction
about.lead: I'm a Computing with Cloud Computing student at TU Dublin (Class of 2028) with a deep fascination for the "invisible" side of technology.
paragraphs: My foundation is built on HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Python, but my real interest lies in the complexity of backend architecture and how robust network systems support the modern web.

Right now I'm exploring the intersection of Generative AI and Cybersecurity — keen to understand how emerging AI models can be built into secure, scalable cloud environments. I'm a lifelong learner looking to bridge the gap between basic data filtering and enterprise-level software infrastructure.

items.summary: A full-stack web app that manages and displays student location data in a responsive interface. Built with Svelte and JavaScript on the front end, with Supabase handling storage and retrieval.

items.name: Weather to S3
items.summary: A Python-based data pipeline that fetches live weather data from the OpenWeatherMap API and uploads it as a structured JSON file to an AWS S3 bucket. Each run generates a timestamped file, demonstrating a simple but complete flow from external API to cloud storage.
